title: IBM puts quantum on the cloud
description: IBM Quantum Experience launches, making a 5-qubit processor available to researchers and the public for the first time.

title: 50-qubit milestone
description: IBM builds a 50-qubit prototype, pushing the boundary of what classical computers can simulate.

title: Quantum advantage demonstrated
description: Google claims quantum supremacy. IBM pushes back, sparking a productive debate about benchmarks.

title: Qiskit community grows
description: The Qiskit open-source community crosses 300,000 users. Fall Fest begins as a global university event.

title: 127-qubit Eagle processor
description: IBM releases the Eagle processor, the first to break the 100-qubit barrier in a production system.

title: 433-qubit Osprey
description: IBM Osprey triples the qubit count. Error mitigation techniques make larger circuits practical.

title: 1,121-qubit Condor
description: IBM Condor becomes the first processor to exceed 1,000 qubits. The era of utility-scale quantum begins.

title: Heron and modular systems
description: IBM Heron focuses on quality over quantity. Modular quantum systems connect multiple processors.

title: SQC hosts Fall Fest
description: Symbiosis Quantum Club hosts IBM Qiskit Fall Fest for the first time. 127 attendees across three days.

title: A Decade of Quantum on Cloud
description: Ten years since IBM put quantum on the cloud. SQC hosts Fall Fest again, bigger and bolder.
